title: Bounded nearest-target Image.distance with source-preserving Float64 lowering

entry_inventory.interpretation: Exact API name entries only, including partial signatures and aliases; not complete semantic compatibility or project migration success

implementation.distance: Per scalar band, Euclidean/Manhattan/Chebyshev distance to valid nonzero cells; explicit original pixel-distance kernel only, binary64 radius0..16 retained exactly, skipMasked defaults true; targets0, absent targets NaN NoData.
implementation.kernel_provenance: Original metric/radius plus exact matrix/focus validation; fixed, normalized, scaled and all transformed kernels reject, including identity rotations. Existing generic kernel consumers retain their weights.
implementation.grid_and_extent: Proven finite source grid, full source bounds before all output bands; output ROI/resampling follows search. Six existing driver pushdown constraints are blocked at the distance process. Spatial/time keys and band names retained; missing tiles not invented.
implementation.precision: Move Double casts through eligible raster first/last selection, clipping and masks before native search. Ordinary arithmetic, explicit Float32 casts, source-free conditional values and mixed scalar/raster band reductions keep existing callback policies.
implementation.native: Strict independent canonical Scala wire parser; exact integer squared-radius inclusion; sorted nearest-offset search; source validation/copy before spatial or temporal buffering; Float64 NaN output v.

budgets.scope: Conservative own-kernel setup/read/copy/halo/output work including the repeated validation action; upstream graph, IO and Spark retries have separate costs. Nonzero halo must be smaller than the tile short side.

implementation.last_node: Cached Double operand can add the single required distance node at499→500 without false preflight rejection.

warnings.kind: Existing Rasterio PendingDeprecationWarning, not new dependency-vulnerability findings

official_clients.scope: Synthetic catalog; metric/multiband/map/time/mask/clip/threshold/export graphs. No physical export or user script execution.

precision_regression.scope: Compiled graphs evaluated with a test-only Float32 callback-input model; distance handler deliberately observes its input rather than computing a second reference transform. Native distance is checked separately.
precision_regression.negative_control: Disable the structural rewrite: direct first/clip/updateMask/distance input loses the smallest binary64 subnormal to zero. Fixed graph retains its exact bits.
precision_regression.boundaries: Explicit Float32/arithmetic/mean and source-free paths retain existing order; cycle/depth/work/node boundaries tested.

targeted_probes.scope: Original fixed probes only, not a random API coverage sample

native_distance.scope: actual Float64 GeoTrellis tiles, independent whole-grid Fraction oracle, manual halo and BufferTilesRDD paths; no SparkContext/service/user code
native_distance.reference: Whole finite-grid Fraction radius/distance reference, Decimal120-digit square root; separate from production offset plan.

large_tile_budget.interpretation: Measured admission boundaries, not throughput benchmarks

environment_failure_and_retry.cause: Execution-tool sandbox denied loopback binding, sandbox-exec, process enumeration and test-owned bounded scratch operations.
environment_failure_and_retry.retry: Same frozen code passed all4765 tests with the permissions needed for existing native-runner controls. No test was removed or weakened.

cleanup.retained: Compact success/failure logs, source hashes, manifests and synthetic fixture evidence

not_verified: Meter-unit distance, arbitrary transformed kernels, fastDistanceTransform and general Float64 callbacks

Private real data and Google same-data numerical parity
